toGo.context: Budget planner > leftover card: how much a goal still needs. Joined with other fragments by ' · '.

inPlan.context: Budget planner > leftover card: what this month's plan already pays into the goal. Lowercase fragment.

reached.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the goal is reached.

open.context: Budget planner > leftover card: goal without a target amount.

enough.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the plan's monthly payment is enough to reach the goal by its date. {by} is month and year, e.g. 'Mar 2027'.

shortPlanned.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the goal needs {need} a month to make its date {by}; the plan gives {planned}, missing {short}.

shortNone.message: potrzebuje {need}/mies. do {by}; w planie nic, brakuje {short}
shortNone.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the goal needs {need} a month to make its date {by}, and the plan gives nothing.

overdue.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the goal's target date is in the past. Lowercase fragment.

noDate.message: bez terminu: dodaj go w Edycji, żeby zobaczyć, ile potrzeba
noDate.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the goal has no target date. 'Edit' is the goal's edit button. Lowercase fragment.

noIncome.message: Brak zapisanego dochodu w miesiącu {month}, więc nie ma z czego liczyć.
noIncome.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month ({month}, name alone) has no income logged.

nothingLeft.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month ended with nothing unspent.

nothingLeftSoFar.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month has nothing unspent yet (still running).

nothingLeftOver.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month overspent its income by {over}.

nothingLeftOverSoFar.message: {month}: jak dotąd nic nie zostaje ({over} ponad).
nothingLeftOverSoFar.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month is overspent by {over} so far.

left.context: Budget planner > leftover card: what the previous month left unspent.

leftSoFar.message: Jak dotąd zostaje {amount}; ostateczna kwota będzie znana na koniec miesiąca.
leftSoFar.context: Budget planner > leftover card: the previous month is still running.

title.context: Budget planner: heading of the card choosing which savings goals get the previous month's unspent money. {month} is the month name alone.

intro.message: Dochód minus odłożone minus wydatki. {status} Wybierz jeden cel lub kilka i daj każdemu procent albo stałą kwotę w złotych.
intro.context: Budget planner > leftover card: explanation; {status} is a sentence like '420 zł left.'

noGoals.message: Nie ma jeszcze celów: dodaj cel na karcie Oszczędności.
noGoals.context: Budget planner > leftover card: there are no savings goals.

modeLabel.context: Budget planner > leftover card: accessible label of the %/zł switch for goal {name}.

shareLabel.context: Budget planner > leftover card: accessible label of the percentage field.

fixedLabel.context: Budget planner > leftover card: accessible label of the set amount field.

useShort.context: Budget planner > leftover card: chip that sets the goal's amount to what it's missing this month. Lowercase, short.

keep.context: Budget planner > leftover card: how much of the leftover stays on the account before the goals get theirs.

keepHelp.message: Poduszka na początek miesiąca; cele dzielą to, co ponad nią.
keepHelp.context: Budget planner > leftover card: explanation under 'Keep on the account'.

keepHelpAmount.message: Poduszka na początek miesiąca; cele dzielą to, co ponad nią: {amount}.
keepHelpAmount.context: Budget planner > leftover card: explanation with the amount the goals share.

fixedTooMuch.message: Stałe kwoty dają razem {fixed}, więcej niż {amount} do podziału; są wypełniane po kolei, aż się skończy.
fixedTooMuch.context: Budget planner > leftover card: warning when the set amounts exceed the leftover.

restStays.message: Kolejne {amount} zostaje na koncie; daj któremuś celowi procent, żeby wziął resztę.
restStays.context: Budget planner > leftover card: set amounts leave some money unassigned.

percentages.message: Procenty sumują się do {total}%, a nie do 100%.

splitEvenly.context: Budget planner > leftover card: button that makes the percentages equal.

nonePicked.message: Nic nie wybrano: to, co zostanie, zostaje na koncie i łatwo to wydać.
nonePicked.context: Budget planner > leftover card: warning when no goal is chosen.
